news.title: ↔️ Free agency tracker: Offseason trades, moves
news.summary: We've got you covered on all the major MLB hot stove signings and trades.

news.title: Sources: Dodgers acquire versatile Lewis in trade with Twins
news.summary: The Dodgers acquired infielder Royce Lewis in a trade with the Twins, fulfilling Los Angeles' need for a versatile right-handed hitter to replace Miguel Rojas.

news.title: Sources: Tigers, right-hander Melton agree to 6-year, $46.5M extension
news.summary: Troy Melton, who went 8-5 with a 2.76 ERA in 20 starts this season, has agreed to a six-year, $46.5M contract extension with the Tigers, sources told ESPN.

news.title: Ohtani extends deal with New Balance for remainder of playing career
news.summary: Shohei Ohtani and New Balance have agreed to extend their contract through the remainder of the Dodgers superstar's playing career.

news.title: MLB players' union offers international signing plan, no draft
news.summary: The MLB Players Association proposed changes to international amateur signings, but not an international draft.

news.title: Sources: Loáisiga back to Bronx after agreeing to 2-year deal
news.summary: The Yankees and right-hander Jonathan Loáisiga are in agreement on a two-year deal with a club option for 2029, sources confirmed to ESPN, reuniting the reliever and club after a season apart.
